preconditions.expression: a >= 0 and b >= 0 and c >= 0 and d >= 0
preconditions.description: All input integers a, b, c, and d must be non-negative.
The total count of numbers must be greater than 0 and at most 100,000.

postconditions.description: If it is impossible to construct a beautiful sequence, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('YES') and len(stdout.split()) == a + b + c + d + 1
postconditions.description: If a beautiful sequence can be constructed, output 'YES' followed by the sequence of length a + b + c + d.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(int(stdout.split()[i]) - int(stdout.split()[i+1])) == 1 for i in range(1, len(stdout.split()) - 1))
postconditions.description: The output sequence must be beautiful, meaning the difference between any two consecutive numbers is equal to 1.
